def get(path):
    response = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}{path}")
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

def post(path, payload):
    response = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}{path}", json=payload)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json() if response.content else None

threat_items = threats if isinstance(threats, list) else threats.get("threats", [])
software_items = software if isinstance(software, list) else software.get("software", [])
